messages:
Maya: quick sync — short status readout for cross-team telemetry before sprint planning. main asks: 1) blockers for token-cost attribution schema, 2) owners for latency breakdown dashboards, 3) any PRs that need urgent review.
Chris: thanks — short list: token-cost mapping PR (https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/412) needs one more review (sam?). also there9s an event rename edge-case from the ingest team.
Sam: I can review the PR today afternoon. heads-up: the rename (event.user_id -> event.user.id) touches three downstream transforms.
Leo: re: latency dashboards — I can own the dashboard rollout but need final event schema with the new token fields (token.count, token.type). currently schema_v2 draft is missing token.type.
Maya: noted. Sam, if you take the PR, please verify transform tests and the nightly job smoke. Leo, can you pair with Jen on alert thresholds? Jen: yep — I9ll take thresholds. what SLOs are we targeting for 95th? 150ms for routing + 300ms model time?
Chris: rough target: 95th <= 500ms overall for API surface in hosted env. we can break down later into routing/model. alerts should surface regressions not noise.
Sam: started a quick local run of transform tests. found one failing case for anonymized user events where user.id is null. pushing a fix to the PR branch:
```
// transform patch
if (!event.user || !event.user.id) {
  metrics.increment('token_missing_user');
  return null;
}
```
Sam: will include test for null user and update migration note. tagging @Leo for the dashboard field mapping.
Leo: thanks. small ask — can the event schema include 'token.source' (client|batch|internal)? that helps attribution. if we add token.type, maybe reuse that field for source?
Maya: prefer explicit 'token.source' to keep semantics clear. Chris — can the schema team cut a quick patch?
Chris: I'll queue a schema patch (schema_v2.1) and run the compatibility check. CI-bot: schema_v2.1 compatibility run queued (#87), estimated check time ~8m.
CI-bot: compatibility check complete — 2 downstream consumers flagged (billing-job, realtime-aggregator).
Jen: billing-job owner here — the change will require a small mapping update, not a blocker. realtime-aggregator (cc @Alex) will need a minor patch.
Maya: action items: Sam — finish PR + tests today; Chris — land schema_v2.1 and post compatibility note; Leo — annotate dashboard with token.source and token.type mapping; Jen — set alert thresholds and coordinate with SRE; Maya — I'll consolidate rollout plan and canary window (start with 2% for 24h).
Chris: pinging Alex separately for aggregator patch.
Sam: PR updated and requesting review from Chris and Leo. leaving a migration note in the PR describing null-user behavior.
Maya: thanks all. if anything unexpected, post here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
